children: McDonald's (MCD, Financials) is investing up to $8.5 billion in a new growth push to win back customers through enhancements to its restaurants, menu innovation and bettering its workers.
The fast-food giant plans big investments throughout its restaurant system as it aims to make its locations more contemporary, efficient and friendly under its McDonald's >NEXT strategy.
That spending also will help pay for new menu items as McDonald's tries to give customers additional incentive to visit its locations more often.

The amount of the proposed investment puts execution under the spotlight for investors. Restaurant improvements and menu adjustments often require a considerable up-front investment before any gain in traffic or sales is reflected in results.
The program also emphasizes a focus on the workers, with McDonald's connecting employee experience to speedier service and a more consistent customer experience.
The company is unveiling the strategy as it seeks to enhance its core business and react to evolving consumer preferences and competition in the fast-food industry.
The next driver is whether McDonald's can turn the investment into improved restaurant traffic and comparable sales as the >NEXT strategy rolls out.

title: McDonald's Just Put $8.5 Billion Behind Its Next Big Comeback
